name: BUYER_SIGNAL_OBJECT
purpose: Structured schema for capturing, normalizing, and routing buyer/market signals back into the FGE nervous system for product mutation and future SKU decisions.

raw_sources: question patterns from support or comments

core_metrics.views: integer (from Gumroad analytics if available, or proxy)

qualitative_signals.buyer_language_patterns: array of phrases buyers use to describe value or problem
qualitative_signals.objections_raised: array of explicit concerns or questions
qualitative_signals.feature_requests: array of 'I wish it had...' or 'next version should...' items
qualitative_signals.price_feedback: direct or inferred comments on pricing

outputs.price_mutation: recommended price change or tier adjustment with rationale
outputs.copy_mutation: suggested improvements to sales story, headline, or FAQ based on buyer language
outputs.bundle_mutation: ideas for what to bundle or split in future versions
outputs.next_product_signal: clear demand vector for the next control specimen (e.g. 'Character Ledger Pack', 'Material Doctrine Expansion Kit')
outputs.governance_impact: any signals that should adjust Release Controller thresholds or identity preservation weights

collection_process.frequency_for_first_specimen: Daily for first 14 days, then weekly
collection_process.tooling: gumroad sales summary + sales list + manual log in Notion or simple JSON
collection_process.automation_target: Later version can poll via Gumroad CLI and write to central Telemetry Ledger

integration.provenance: Every signal batch should be timestamped and linked back to the originating SKU and product version

language_patterns: "finally something that measures whether my characters stay consistent"
"I didn't realize how much identity drift I had until I used this"
objections: "Is this just a PDF guide?" (addressed in FAQ but still appearing)
example_signal_record.next_product_signal: Strong interest in applying the same workflow to character bibles and material doctrine packs
recommended_actions: Add short video walkthrough in v0.1.1
Create follow-up product: SDU Character Ledger System

status: Defined - ready to be used as the output schema for the first buyer signal collection after SDU-COM-001 launch
